highlights.brief: braindecode 延续昨日的爆发：单日 **30 提交**，主题从「加模型」转向**清扫静默错误**。旗舰是 **#1608：所有基础模型接受 `channel_strategy`——通道对不上就映射，或带明确理由拒绝**（本 lane 连日呼吁的方向），配套 #1605 给 **23 个基础模型**补上通道数不匹配的清晰 ValueError。最触目的是 **#1655：TUH 的 `add_physician_reports` 此前把 `_date.txt` 当医生报告读入**——凡基于该管线做临床报告 NLP，特征字段实为日期串。**#1686 FilterBankLayer 以因果方式应用最小相位 FIR**（模型内非因果滤波=向预测泄漏未来）、#1657/#1679 保 IIR 精度与 LUNA 谱相位。「拒绝也要给理由」值得所有 EEG 工具链抄。

highlights.title_zh: MNE-Python：eLORETA 松散方向先验多年用错公式（sqrt(prior) 应为 prior），维护者公开致谢 Claude 定位根因
highlights.title_en: MNE-Python: eLORETA's Loose Prior Used sqrt(prior) Instead of prior for Years; Maintainer Credits Claude for Root-Cause Hunt
highlights.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14568，修掉一个**多年沿用的源定位公式错误**：eLORETA 的 `loose` 方向先验此前对增益矩阵施加 **`sqrt(prior)` 而正确做法是 `prior`**，且在不同代码路径施加不一致。修复统一为一致地施加一次并弃用 `force_equal`。两点值得注意：①eLORETA 是 EEG/MEG 源成像的默认方法之一，先验公式错会系统性改变深度偏置与伪解分布——不报错、不可见；用 MNE 做过 loose eLORETA 的已发表定位结果值得标注版本边界。②PR 正文**公开写明「我让 Claude Opus 5.5 对照原始论文调查根因并起草了修复」**——核心数值算法的 AI 辅助调试＋人类核实＋公开署名，这个流程样本比修复本身更值得行业抄。

highlights.title_zh: EEG-ExPy 加入 Muse S Athena 采集与对齐传感器流：消费级头环进实验框架

highlights.brief: EEG-ExPy 合并 #349：**新增 Muse S Athena 采集后端，并输出与 EEG 时间对齐的传感器流**。EEG-ExPy 是近十年心理与应用电生理领域最常用的 Python 实验框架之一（呈现＋打点＋同步一体化），此前官方支持的设备以 Lab Streaming Layer/BrainFlow 通用路径为主——**为具体消费级头环做专用后端并保证传感器流对齐**，意味着用 Muse S Athena 就能搭「刺激呈现-采集-行为标注」闭环而无需自写蓝牙桥接与手工对齐。对教学实验室与预实验尤其实际：Muse 系价格带＋官方框架支持＝可复现的最小配置。注意消费级头环的电极噪声与参考限制仍在（本 lane 连日的参考主题同样适用），但工程门槛确实又降一档。

items.title_en: braindecode Silent-Error Sweep Day: Channel Mapping Maps or Refuses with a Reason; TUH Read Date Files as Physician Reports
bullets_zh: **#1608：所有基础模型接受 `channel_strategy`——通道对不上时「映射，或带明确理由拒绝」**；**#1605 给 23 个基础模型加了通道数不匹配的清晰 ValueError**。昨日「读错张量」的教训直接变成平台侧防线。
**#1655：TUH 数据集 `add_physician_reports` 此前把 `_date.txt` 侧车文件当医生报告读入**——临床 NLP 的特征字段实为日期字符串。
同日 **#1686 FilterBankLayer 改为因果最小相位 FIR**、#1657 IIR 系数跨 dtype 保精度、#1679 LUNA 在 MPS 上的谱相位（上周 GPU 相位修复续篇）——单日 **30 提交**，大半是静默错误类。
bullets_en: #1608: every foundation model now accepts channel_strategy — mismatched channels get mapped or refused with an explicit reason; #1605 adds clear ValueErrors for channel-count mismatches across 23 models. Yesterday's wrong-tensor lesson became a platform-side guard.
#1655: TUH add_physician_reports previously read the _date.txt side file as the physician report — clinical NLP features were date strings.

Same day #1686 made FilterBankLayer minimum-phase FIR causal, #1657 kept IIR design precision across dtype conversions, #1679 fixed LUNA spectral phase on MPS — ~30 commits, mostly silent-error fixes.
items.brief: braindecode 延续昨日的爆发：单日 **30 提交**，主题从「加模型」转向**清扫静默错误**。旗舰是 **#1608：所有基础模型接受 `channel_strategy`——通道对不上就映射，或带明确理由拒绝**（本 lane 连日呼吁的方向），配套 #1605 给 **23 个基础模型**补上通道数不匹配的清晰 ValueError。最触目的是 **#1655：TUH 的 `add_physician_reports` 此前把 `_date.txt` 当医生报告读入**——凡基于该管线做临床报告 NLP，特征字段实为日期串。**#1686 FilterBankLayer 以因果方式应用最小相位 FIR**（模型内非因果滤波=向预测泄漏未来）、#1657/#1679 保 IIR 精度与 LUNA 谱相位。「拒绝也要给理由」值得所有 EEG 工具链抄。
items.brief_en: braindecode's 30-commit day swept silent errors: #1608 makes every foundation model accept channel_strategy — map or refuse with a reason; #1605 adds clear ValueErrors across 23 models. #1655 caught TUH reading _date.txt as the physician report. #1686 made FilterBankLayer FIR causal; #1657/#1679 kept filter precision and LUNA MPS phase correct.
items.raw_excerpt: Commits 2026-11-19: "ENH models: every foundation model accepts channel_strategy (maps or refuses with a reason) (#1608)"; "FIX models: clear ValueError when the input's channel count does not match (23 foundation models) (#1605)"; "FIX TUH: add_physician_reports no longer reads the _date.txt side file as the report (#1655)"; "FIX FilterBankLayer: apply minimum-phase FIR filters causally (#1686)".
items.why_valuable: 「拒绝也要给理由」成平台防线；TUH 日期当报告直接污染临床 NLP。

items.title_zh: MNE-Python：eLORETA 松散方向先验多年用错公式（sqrt(prior) 应为 prior），维护者公开致谢 Claude 定位根因
items.title_en: MNE-Python: eLORETA's Loose Prior Used sqrt(prior) Instead of prior for Years; Maintainer Credits Claude for Root-Cause Hunt
bullets_zh: #14568：eLORETA 的 `loose` 实现**对增益矩阵施加了 `sqrt(prior)` 而应为 `prior`**，且施加方式前后不一致——多年沿用的源定位数值错误。
修复统一为「一致地施加一次 prior」并弃用 `force_equal`；PR 正文**明确披露由 Claude Opus 5.5 通过原始论文调查根因并起草修复**——AI 辅助调试核心算法的公开署名样本。
eLORETA 是 EEG/MEG 源成像默认方法之一：先验错公式会系统性改变定位深度偏置，且不会报错。
bullets_en: #14568: the loose implementation applied sqrt(prior) to the gain matrix where prior was correct, and applied it inconsistently — a long-standing numerical error in source localization.

The fix applies prior once consistently and deprecates force_equal; the PR openly discloses that Claude Opus 5.5 investigated the root cause against original papers and drafted fixes — a public attribution sample for AI-assisted core-algorithm debugging.
eLORETA is a default EEG/MEG source-imaging method: a wrong prior formula shifts depth bias systematically without ever erroring.
items.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14568，修掉一个**多年沿用的源定位公式错误**：eLORETA 的 `loose` 方向先验此前对增益矩阵施加 **`sqrt(prior)` 而正确做法是 `prior`**，且在不同代码路径施加不一致。修复统一为一致地施加一次并弃用 `force_equal`。两点值得注意：①eLORETA 是 EEG/MEG 源成像的默认方法之一，先验公式错会系统性改变深度偏置与伪解分布——不报错、不可见；用 MNE 做过 loose eLORETA 的已发表定位结果值得标注版本边界。②PR 正文**公开写明「我让 Claude Opus 5.5 对照原始论文调查根因并起草了修复」**——核心数值算法的 AI 辅助调试＋人类核实＋公开署名，这个流程样本比修复本身更值得行业抄。
items.brief_en: MNE-Python #14568 fixes a long-standing eLORETA error: the loose prior applied sqrt(prior) to the gain matrix instead of prior, inconsistently across paths. Fixed by applying prior once consistently; force_equal deprecated. The PR openly credits Claude Opus 5.5 for root-cause investigation against original papers — a model AI-assisted debugging workflow.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #14568: "I had Claude Opus 5.5 help me (by investigating the root cause via original papers and drafting fixes to) solve a long-standing problem with the `loose` implementation I put in place for eLORETA. It turns out we were applying `sqrt(prior)` when we should have been applying `prior` to the gain matrix. We also had a bug with applying it inconsistently…"
items.why_valuable: 默认源定位方法多年用错先验公式；AI 查根因＋公开署名的流程样本更稀缺。

bullets_zh: #349（11-19 合并）：**EEG-ExPy 实验框架新增 Muse S Athena 采集后端**，并提供**与 EEG 时间对齐的传感器流**（加速度计/陀螺仪等）。
EEG-ExPy 是心理/应用电生理最常用的 Python 实验呈现＋同步框架之一；官方后端意味着**无需自写蓝牙桥接**即可做「刺激呈现-采集」闭环。
对预算敏感实验室：Muse 系头环＋开源实验框架的组合门槛进一步降低；对齐传感器流也让伪迹回归更规范。
bullets_en: #349 (merged Nov 19): the EEG-ExPy framework gains a Muse S Athena acquisition backend plus sensor streams time-aligned with EEG.
EEG-ExPy is among the most-used Python stimulus-presentation and sync frameworks; an official backend means closed-loop presentation-acquisition without hand-rolled Bluetooth bridges.
For budget-constrained labs: Muse headbands plus an open experiment framework lower the barrier further, and aligned sensor streams make artefact regression principled.

items.brief_en: EEG-ExPy merged #349: a Muse S Athena acquisition backend with sensor streams time-aligned to EEG. An official dedicated backend for a consumer headband means closed-loop presentation-acquisition-labelling without hand-rolled Bluetooth bridges — a reproducible minimal rig for teaching labs, artefact caveats notwithstanding.
